title: X-Stage: Modeling Post-Issue Backpressure in GPU Communication--Computation Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2607.23264v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fine-grained, device-initiated communication allows fused GPU kernels to issue remote stores directly from their compute pipelines, a pattern increasingly used in expert parallelism (EP), tensor parallelism (TP), and Ulysses-style sequence parallelism (UP). Existing designs reason about where communication is issued and when remote data becomes ready, but lack a quantitative model of the sender-side interval after a remote store is accepted and before it becomes visible at the destination. This interval determines whether communication remains decoupled from computation or backpressures it. We identify X-Stage, a software-visible post-issue stage with finite decoupling. Downstream pressure can dissipate while the issuer resumes useful work, whereas sustained injection consumes X-Stage headroom and eventually stalls the compute pipeline. translated_title: X-Stage：GPU通信-计算融合中发布后背压的建模
translated_abstract: 细粒度、由设备发起的通信允许融合的GPU内核直接从其计算流水线发出远程存储操作，这种模式在专家并行（EP）、张量并行（TP）和Ulysses式序列并行（UP）中的应用日益增多。现有设计关注通信发出的位置以及远程数据何时就绪，但缺乏对远程存储被接受之后、在目的地变为可见之前的发送端时间间隔的定量模型。这个时间间隔决定了通信是与计算保持解耦，还是会对其产生背压。我们识别出X-Stage，这是一个软件可见的、具有有限解耦能力的发布后阶段。当发射方恢复有用工作时，下游压力可以消散；而持续的数据注入则会消耗X-Stage的余量，最终导致计算流水线停顿。我们对这种行为进行了表征，并建立了一个经过校准的模型，用于预测远程存储是否……
tldr: 该论文识别出GPU通信-计算融合中的X-Stage——一个软件可见、解耦能力有限的发布后阶段，并通过校准模型预测远程存储何时与计算解耦、何时产生背压导致计算流水线停顿。
